description.en: Plays a tactic cutscene, disabling the map/camera pause bit and the automatic end-fade-in system flag for its duration, then restoring them once the cutscene finishes.
Tactic ID whose cutscene to play.
Handle of the attacking team's model.
Handle of the defending team's model.
Optional technique map to use for the cutscene (defaults to "").
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Play a tactic cutscene between an attacking and defending team model
RunTactics("vet0001", hAtk, hDef, "mf01i21");
